Source: https://github.com/facebook/zstd v1.5.6, the decompressor only: `zstddeclib.c` is the single-file decoder that zstd's own `build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_decoder.sh` makes (`combine.py -r lib -x legacy/zstd_legacy.h -o zstddeclib.c zstddeclib-in.c`), unmodified. It defines `ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM` (plain C, no x86 Huffman assembly) and has no legacy formats, no dictionary builder and no compressor. License in LICENSE (BSD; zstd is dual-licensed BSD or GPLv2, the BSD terms are taken here).
Use: the Android Vulkan replay decompresses the shader library's modules with it (`dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_shlib.c`, codec `DMSH_VK_CODEC_ZSTD` of `dm/gfx/nvn/dmsh_abi_vk.h`). `android/host/CMakeLists.txt` builds it as the static library `zstddec`; the Mac unit test `t_android_shlib` (`dm/host/tests`) compiles the same file.
